name: Mayor's Circle of Excellence Day Camp
description_short: East Orange YMCA day camp at Lincoln Avenue School in Orange for ages 6 to 13 (6 year olds must be entering grade 1), with outdoor games, creative projects, team activities, weekly trips and swimming at the Central Playground pool. Breakfast, lunch and an afternoon snack are served daily.

fees.name: Extra camp t-shirt
fees.note: One shirt is included; extras are $10 each

refund_policy_summary: Changes are free through January 31, 2027. Full refund for cancellations by April 1, 2027; from April 2 all payments, including deposits, are forfeited, and there are no credits for absence or illness. Changes through the Welcome Center or after April 2 cost $35 per child per request. The East Orange YMCA registration fee is non-refundable.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swims at the Central Playground pool, 371 Central Avenue, Orange.

sessions.name: Summer 2027 (sessions sold separately; no camp July 5)

notes: Rate is $260 per session ($247 early bird, December 1, 2026 to January 31, 2027); City of Orange residents get a discount the page does not print. A non-refundable 5% down payment ($13 per session) is due at registration and counts toward the fee. Camp runs Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.; Week 7 meets at 650 Nassau Street, Orange. A Counselor in Training camp for ages 13 to 15 runs at the same school June 28 to August 6 at $162 per session. Program for Parents accepted. Y for All financial assistance available.
